title: Decision 2: each Mercadona candidate gets a product of its own, and the container goes in both names of a pair
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood at the start of the stage of plan 0192 that changed it (the items-snapshot of that stage). A product that a stage created is keyed as the create answered it. Each queue row is keyed as it stood at the start of stage 1 (stage-c1/rows-snapshot.c0-start.json).
note: The container or the count was read from the stored link of each row. The harvester stores no detail payload.

entries.ownerDecision: Decided by the owner, 2026-10-06: the row gets a product of its own, created from the row, with the container in the name. The Coca-Cola rows take a pack count after their detail is read.
entries.why: Prints '3 Bocadillos', no brand, 0.39 kg, 1.10, EAN 8402001028397. Its link ends in '3-bocadillos-andaluces'. Its sibling ext 11633 prints the same name, is UNRESOLVED and links to '3-vienas-andaluzas': another bread. No product holds the barcode. The count of the name goes to the pack count, and 'andaluces' from the link keeps it apart from the sibling when that one is decided. Only two of the three warehouses hold a price for the row.
